activity.notes: Shinzo Abe returned to the premiership on 26 December 2012 and remained continuously in office through subsequent cabinet formations and re-designations in 2014 and 2017. Those re-designations did not create an out-of-office interval, so ATLAS models one continuous Prime Minister Activity from 26 December 2012 until the Abe Cabinet resigned en masse on 16 September 2020.

sources.title: 96th ABE Shinzo - Previous Prime Ministers
sources.citation_text: The Prime Minister's Office of Japan lists ABE Shinzo as the 96th Prime Minister beginning on December 26, 2012.

sources.title: Designation of the Prime Minister - December 26, 2012
sources.citation_text: The Prime Minister's Office records that Shinzo Abe was designated Prime Minister on December 26, 2012 and became the 96th Prime Minister.

sources.title: 97th ABE Shinzo - Previous Prime Ministers
sources.citation_text: The official 97th-prime-minister page records Abe's December 24, 2014 reappointment and the continuation of his premiership into 2017.

sources.title: 98th ABE Shinzo - Previous Prime Ministers
sources.citation_text: The official 98th-prime-minister page records the final segment of Abe's premiership from November 1, 2017 to September 16, 2020.

sources.title: The Resignation En Masse of the Abe Cabinet
sources.citation_text: The Prime Minister's Office records that the Abe Cabinet resigned en masse on September 16, 2020, marking the end of Abe's second continuous premiership.
